description: "Commits a human-decided ShiftPlan: one or more PathPlan lines (path, plannedHeads, plannedRate, plannedHours), raising ShiftPlanCommitted. Validates, per line, that plannedHeads does not exceed the caller-supplied installedStations for that path (this context enforces the invariant independently — it has no dependency on Work Planning, which owns installed-station counts — the request carries the number it needs), that plannedHeads does not exceed the LIVE installed capacity fulfillment-execution reports for that path's capability (a SEPARATE, independent check — see ADR-0014; fetched fresh on every commit, and this service fails the entire commit loud, without any fallback, if fulfillment-execution cannot be reached), and that plannedHours does not exceed plannedHeads * the configured max hours per shift. Naturally idempotent by the client-supplied (buildingId, shiftId) key: the underlying repository upserts on that key."

<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}

Commits a human-decided ShiftPlan: one or more PathPlan lines (path, plannedHeads, plannedRate, plannedHours), raising ShiftPlanCommitted. Validates, per line, that plannedHeads does not exceed the caller-supplied installedStations for that path (this context enforces the invariant independently — it has no dependency on Work Planning, which owns installed-station counts — the request carries the number it needs), that plannedHeads does not exceed the LIVE installed capacity fulfillment-execution reports for that path's capability (a SEPARATE, independent check — see ADR-0014; fetched fresh on every commit, and this service fails the entire commit loud, without any fallback, if fulfillment-execution cannot be reached), and that plannedHours does not exceed plannedHeads * the configured max hours per shift. Naturally idempotent by the client-supplied (buildingId, shiftId) key: the underlying repository upserts on that key.
